turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Tell me what brought you in today.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I want to discuss pain in my chest.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: What does the pain feel like?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: It feels like a heavy pressure in the middle of my chest.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: When did the pain start, and did it begin suddenly or gradually?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: It started gradually yesterday afternoon.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Does walking or climbing stairs bring it on?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Yes, walking brings it on.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: What makes the pain better, like resting or taking anything for it?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Resting makes it better. I have not taken any medicine for it.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Does the pain spread to your arm, jaw, neck, or back?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No, it stays in one spot.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Do you break out in a sweat with the pain?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No, I have not noticed sweating.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Do you feel short of breath with the pain?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No, my breathing feels the same.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Have you fainted, felt lightheaded, or felt like you might pass out?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No, none of those.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Has a close relative had heart disease at a young age?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No, not that I know of.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Do you smoke, or have high blood pressure, diabetes, or high cholesterol?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I do not smoke. I have high blood pressure, but no diabetes or high cholesterol.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: What heart procedures have you had before?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I had a coronary stent placed several years ago.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: We will review your medicine list together before this visit ends. Please bring that list to your next appointment.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I understand those two steps. I have no other questions today.
